story_description: Define theme models and built-in theme presets for the settings system.
task_description: The app needs a structured data model to represent themes with colors, glass levels, accent options, and font overrides. Without this, theme data would be scattered and inconsistent.
atom_description: The app needs a structured data model to represent themes with colors, glass levels, accent options, and font overrides. Without this, theme data would be scattered and inconsistent.
problem_statement: The app needs a structured data model to represent themes with colors, glass levels, accent options, and font overrides. Without this, theme data would be scattered and inconsistent.
scope_in: Define ThemeProfile struct with all theme properties; implement Codable conformance; provide default values
Implement ThemeProfile.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Theme persistence (handled by ThemeStore); theme application logic (handled by ThemeManager); built-in theme definitions (handled by BuiltInThemes)
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.

functional_requirements: ThemeProfile stores: id (UUID), name (String), isBuiltIn (Bool), colors (ThemeColors), glassLevel (DSGlassLevel), accentOption (AccentColorOption), fontOverrides (FontOverrides?)
ThemeProfile conforms to Identifiable, Codable, Equatable
Use DSGlass styling for any settings panels or UI surfaces.
Persist user choices via the specified storage mechanism.
ThemeProfile default values match Nebula baseline colors, glass level, and typography.
Accent options use the preset palette defined in the spec.
Font overrides store UI and monospace font families plus size multiplier.
nonfunctional_requirements: Encoding/decoding must complete in <1ms for typical themes
Must not block the main UI thread.
implementation_steps: Add Codable conformance with CodingKeys if needed
Add static `default` property returning Nebula-like defaults
Add unit test for encode/decode round-trip
Review the ThemeProfile.swift section in docs/settings-development.md and confirm required fields and flows.

edge_cases: Decoding theme with missing optional fields (fontOverrides) - should use nil
Theme with empty name - validation should reject in ThemeStore, not here
UUID collision (astronomically unlikely) - no special handling needed
failure_modes: JSON decode failure due to schema mismatch - throw DecodingError, caller handles
